heroHeading: Born in Malaysia. Raised on street food.
heroDescription: What started as showing friends around Chow Kit market has become 15 years of sharing the real Malaysia, one meal at a time.
seo_title: About Simply Enak  -  Malaysian Food Tours Since 2011
seo_description: Learn the story behind Simply Enak. Since 2011, we have been sharing Malaysia food heritage through walking food tours in Kuala Lumpur and Penang.
